correctness.rationale: Evaluation differences in the unnormalized arclength mean-zero H^1 energy Hilbert space have squared norm equal to effective resistance, giving Green diagonal F(x)/L-J/(2L^2), F(x)=integral r(x,y)dy. For an edge of length ell, F interpolates endpoint values plus [L(ell-r_e)-ell^2]z(1-z), so every edge orbit has a strictly interior quadratic maximizer for n>=4,h>0. Rank-one inversion of the complete-graph Laplacian gives r_d=2h/(2+(n-2)h), r_m=(2nh-3h+3)/(n[2+(n-2)h]), r_o=2/n. Exact rational peak differences compare distinguished, mixed and ordinary edges: at n=4, M_m-M_o=-(h-1)(h^2+4h-1)/(4(3h^2+12h+17)), giving unique h=sqrt(5)-2 transition in (0,1); at n>=5 convex Q_n(h) has negative endpoint values and stays negative for 0<h<1; h>1 selects distinguished edge. Equality functions are centered Green representers. Independently checked the n=4 symbolic factor and rational peak order for n=4 and 5 with h=1/10,1/2,2; finite checks are not the universal sign proof.
